title: Chibi Character Comic Creator
h1: Create Comics with Cute Chibi Characters
description: Design adorable chibi-style comics with oversized heads and big expressions.
intro: Bring cuteness overload to your comic strips.

faqs.question: What is chibi style?
faqs.answer: Chibi is a highly stylized caricature format where characters are small and chubby, often used for comedic effect.

faqs.question: Can I mix different character styles?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can combine chibi characters with more realistic props or backgrounds to create a unique look.
